name: com.kinetixseo/mcp
title: KinetixSEO
description: SEO and AI search checks for any website, plus your KinetixSEO audits, keywords and citations.

tools.name: start_url_audit
tools.description: Start a KinetixSEO SEO and AI-visibility audit for one URL. Returns a job_id; poll get_url_audit with it until the audit is complete. Costs 1 credit per call from the caller's KinetixSEO credit balance.

tools.name: get_url_audit
tools.description: Fetch the status and, once complete, the result of an audit started with start_url_audit: the SEO health and AI search readiness scores, the summary, and the open findings ranked by priority, each with a recommendation. result_url opens the full report. Free: spends no credits.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by start_url_audit.

tools.name: start_content_brief
tools.description: Build a content brief for one of the caller's tracked keywords. Returns immediately; call get_content_brief for the brief once it is built. Rebuilding replaces the keyword's previous brief. Costs 0.31 credits per call from the caller's KinetixSEO credit balance.

tracked_keyword_id.description: ID of the tracked keyword to build a content brief for.

tools.name: get_content_brief
tools.description: Fetch the content brief for a tracked keyword once start_content_brief has finished building it. Free: spends no credits.

tracked_keyword_id.description: ID of the tracked keyword whose content brief to fetch.

tools.name: start_keyword_research
tools.description: Run keyword research from up to 10 seed keywords. Returns a research_id; poll get_keyword_research with it for the result. Costs 0.05 credits per call from the caller's KinetixSEO credit balance.

mode.description: topic (default): one page plan per topic with a primary and secondary keywords. buyer_intent: a list of bottom-of-funnel phrases, one short landing page each, sorted easiest-to-rank first.

search_market.description: Country and language to research in, e.g. "nl-nl" for Google Netherlands in Dutch. Defaults to "us-en".

tools.name: get_keyword_research
tools.description: Fetch the status and, once complete, the result of a keyword research run started with start_keyword_research. Free: spends no credits.

research_id.description: The research ID returned by TriggerKeywordResearch.

tools.name: get_backlink_summary
tools.description: Fetch the latest stored backlink summary for a domain the caller tracks (total backlinks, referring domains, domain rating). Returns has_data:false if no snapshot exists yet; it never triggers a new fetch. A domain that is not one of the caller's tracked sites returns an error. Free: spends no credits.

domain.description: The domain to fetch backlink stats for, e.g. example.com.

tools.name: start_llms_txt_generation
tools.description: Generate an AI-summarized llms.txt for a domain: crawls the site and summarizes each page. Returns a generation_id; poll get_llms_txt with it for the files. For a free, non-AI llms.txt use https://kinetixseo.com/tools/llms-txt-generator instead. Costs 0.04 credits per call from the caller's KinetixSEO credit balance.

domain.description: The domain to generate an llms.txt for, e.g. example.com.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: Fetch the status and, once complete, the llms.txt and llms-full.txt content of a generation started with start_llms_txt_generation. A file too large to return here is left out (null) and its download URL is given instead. Free: spends no credits.

generation_id.description: The generation ID returned by start_llms_txt_generation.

tools.name: get_geo_citation_status
tools.description: Fetch AI visibility (GEO) status for a tracked keyword the caller owns: the training-memory named rate (how often models answering from memory name the site) with per-model detail, the retrieval-grounded citation checks, and the visibility ranking against competitors. has_data:false with a reason means nothing is measured yet: the zeros are not a result. With has_data:true the training-memory rate can still be null when only live-search engines answered; read ground_truth then. Free: spends no credits.

tracked_keyword_id.description: ID of the tracked keyword to fetch GEO citation status for.

tools.name: list_tracked_sites
tools.description: List the sites tracked in the caller's KinetixSEO account: id, domain, label, whether tracking is active, and how many keywords (and GEO keywords) each site tracks. Read-only. Free: spends no credits.

tools.name: list_tracked_keywords
tools.description: List the keywords tracked in the caller's KinetixSEO account, optionally for one site (tracked_site_id from list_tracked_sites). Each keyword's id is the tracked_keyword_id that get_geo_citation_status and start_content_brief take. Read-only. Free: spends no credits.

tracked_site_id.description: Optional: only list keywords of this tracked site (an id from list_tracked_sites). Leave out to list every site's keywords.

tools.name: start_website_check
tools.description: Start KinetixSEO's free website check for a domain: technical SEO health and AI search readiness of the home page, scored, with the open findings ranked by priority. It runs in the background for up to a few minutes; call get_website_check with the ID it returns to read the result. A domain checked in the last 24 hours returns that result straight away. No KinetixSEO account needed. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is scanned.

tools.name: get_website_check
tools.description: Read the status and, once done, the result of a check started with start_website_check: the SEO health score, the AI search readiness score, counts by severity and the open findings ranked by priority, each with a recommendation. No KinetixSEO account needed. Free: spends no credits.

tools.name: check_structured_data
tools.description: Validate the JSON-LD structured data on a website's home page: parse errors, schema.org types, required properties, breadcrumb and FAQ shape, deprecated types and conflicting ids. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_meta_tags
tools.description: Check a website's home page title and meta description length, canonical tag, meta robots directives, and whether it has a clear H1 that matches the title. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_robots_and_sitemap
tools.description: Validate a website's robots.txt and XML sitemaps: robots.txt syntax, which AI crawlers it allows or blocks, the Sitemap directive, sitemap XML validity, URL counts against the protocol limits, child sitemaps of a sitemap index, and lastmod coverage. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_security_headers
tools.description: Check the HTTP security headers a website's home page sends: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and cookie flags. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_ssl_certificate
tools.description: Check a website's TLS setup: certificate expiry and days remaining, chain validity, hostname match, negotiated TLS version, cipher strength, and whether HTTP redirects to HTTPS. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_dns_health
tools.description: Check a domain's DNS: SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, nameserver redundancy, MX records, and common misconfigurations such as multiple SPF records. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_ai_search_readiness
tools.description: Score how ready a website's home page is to be read and quoted by AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews: citability, brand and entity consistency, structure, AI crawler access and supporting media. It measures readiness, not whether AI assistants actually cite the site. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_broken_links
tools.description: Find broken links on a website's home page: lists the page's links and checks a sample of them live, reporting each one's status, plus target=_blank links missing rel=noopener. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

tools.name: check_redirects
tools.description: Trace the redirects of a URL on four versions (http and https, with and without www.), hop by hop up to 10, and report loops, chains, temporary redirects, https-to-http downgrades, meta refreshes, a final page that does not answer 200, and versions that end on different pages. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The URL to check: a domain (example.com) checks its home page; a full URL (example.com/old-page) checks that page, path and query kept.
